pages.title: Data Layer Architecture and Public Surface
pages.purpose: Explain the repository’s owned multi-asset EOD data system, package and CLI entrypoints, importable public contract surface, runtime domains, dependency/lazy-import boundaries, and the boundary between this code and deployment scripts that reference unavailable venue components.
instructions: Include a source-grounded Mermaid component/data-flow diagram for the CLI, configuration, collectors, persistence, synchronization, and health domains.

pages.title: Market Data Store, Contract, and Split Adjustment
pages.purpose: Document the seven-column input/export contract; Parquet partition schema and raw-versus-derived lineage; split and dividend persistence; pure CRSP adjustment invariants; reconciliation behavior; and locking, atomic-write, and recovery guarantees that constrain storage changes.
instructions: Include source-grounded Mermaid diagrams for the stored data lineage and the adjustment/reconciliation control flow.

pages.title: Universe Declarations and Classification Evidence
pages.purpose: Explain the normalized universe model, strict TOML validation, provider/source and modeled-source rules, asset-class-to-store-type mapping, window declarations, and the deliberately separate vendor-evidence check whose result can warn but cannot override configuration.
instructions: Include a source-grounded Mermaid diagram of asset, source, declared class, stored series, and classification-evidence relationships.

pages.title: Provider Collectors and HTTP Transport
pages.purpose: Describe the common collector/transport seam, retry and quota behavior, fixture recording/replay safety, secret redaction, and the distinct EODHD and Binance symbol, pagination, basis, and volume semantics that callers must preserve.
instructions: Include a source-grounded Mermaid sequence diagram for a collector request through rate limiting, retry/error handling, transport, and provider response normalization.

pages.title: Daily Run, Offline Health, and Publication Gates
pages.purpose: Document the scheduled shell orchestration around sync and status, S3 restore/publish gating, exit-code and timeout behavior, offline source and cross-venue health verdicts, diagnostics/telemetry posture, and the explicit boundary to externally supplied event/dashboard implementations.
instructions: Include a source-grounded Mermaid flowchart of restore, sync, status, binning invocation, green-gated persistence, and always-best-effort telemetry/dashboard publication; distinguish unavailable external implementations from code in this repository.

pages.title: Verification Seams and Safe Change Checks
pages.purpose: Give maintainers a repository-specific safety checklist: document the absence of in-tree tests, injectable clocks/transports/collectors and replay/recording seams, invariants to preserve across contract/store/sync/health changes, and the available CLI validation, dry-run, export, differential, and status checks.

pages.title: Universe Sync, Tail Refresh, and Reconciliation
pages.purpose: Trace `jef-data sync` from universe selection through provider-specific action/load ordering, first-fill and persistent windows, crypto end guards, tail refetch and newest-wins revision handling, adjustment, per-leg failure containment, and machine-readable summaries.
instructions: Include a source-grounded Mermaid flowchart or sequence diagram showing leg selection, the raw-basis corporate-actions-before-load branch, tail reconciliation, and independent leg failures.

pages.title: JEF Data Layer Change Guide
pages.purpose: Route contributors from the `jef-data` command and packaged configuration to the architecture, storage, integration, sync, operations, and verification pages; state the repository’s data-layer scope and the external deployment references that are not implemented here.
